If you're going for Thorns Damage, the Thorns of the Invoker set will make your build outstanding. The Helm of Command and the Justice Lantern are two items that add significant block chance if that's what you want (I think those are the right item names.) If you join the Voat Goats (our brand spanking new clan), I can carry you on T6 the next time I'm on and you'll have plenty of set gear in no time.

In terms of paragon points, it is usually good to max out Movement Speed first. If you find you need better healing go with LoH over Resource Cost Reduction. And in terms of the offense category, I'm a sucker for Crit Hit Chance. Unless your build relies on hitting a specific breakpoint, attack speed is usually not nearly as effective in actually raising your damage. And Crit Damage is handled fairly well initially by an emerald in your weapon, and a good Amulet. Resist All will help handle the elemental damage from Elites so focus on that first in the defensive category.
